demo.urlTitle: What to type as the address
demo.urlHelp: With no hint words the address leads to an empty repository, or to a ready project when downloading one. Words in the address change the outcome: same, unrelated, other, plain, newer, empty. Failures: auth (needs a token), denied (token rejected), sso, readonly, offline, missing, tls, slow, limit. An unknown ssh server asks you to confirm its key, and the word changed gives "server key changed" (github.com). A branch that does not exist (other than main and develop) gives "no such branch".
